scenes.desc: {{giver}}'s contact waits for you in a back room. They check the goods in silence, then nod. Clean transaction.
You find the recipient after twenty minutes searching the corridors. They look at the item, then at you. "You're late." They pay anyway.
The recipient is there, but not alone. Two figures in the shadows. They ask if you were followed.
You arrive at the address given — the place is closed. A note pinned to the door says to go to the lower level.
On the way to the delivery, someone shoves past you in the corridor and deliberately knocks over your crate. Eyes turn toward you.
The recipient is there but initially refuses the goods. "Terms have changed." They try to renegotiate downward.

heistScenes.desc: You hand the item to {{giver}}. They don't even look at it — they already knew what it was. Payment comes without a word.
Someone else was after this item. They're right there in the corridor, and they saw you.
The handoff happens. {{giver}} examines the item for a long time. "This is the one." They pay. But you wonder how long they'd been waiting for exactly this.

fuelScavenge.hisConditionsLine: "I have what you need. But nothing's free here. Here's what I'll take."
fuelScavenge.criticalDesc: Your tank is empty. You can't leave from here. This station doesn't sell fuel — but that doesn't mean there isn't any. All options are risky.
fuelScavenge.stealDiscreetly: 🔧 Steal discreetly — silent if it works
fuelScavenge.takeByForce: ⚔ Take by force — combat, victory = +2 fuel
fuelScavenge.stealSuccess: +{{amount}} fuel. You empty an unwatched container and disappear. Someone might have noticed. (-3 rep)
fuelScavenge.alarmTriggered: Alarm triggered. You back off with nothing. Next time they'll be waiting. (-5 rep)
fuelScavenge.payCreditsDesc: "Cash. No trace, no receipt. You have it or you don't."
fuelScavenge.emptyCargoDesc: "I'll take everything you've got in there. All of it. {{cargo}}. Then we're even."
fuelScavenge.emptyCargoDeal: They empty your hold without a word. You leave empty-handed but +3 fuel.
fuelScavenge.personalFavorDesc: They look you slowly up and down, lingering. "I want a favor. The... personal kind." They wait for your answer, smiling.
fuelScavenge.personalFavorDeal: You close your eyes to your dignity. +2 fuel. (-5 rep)
fuelScavenge.giveWeaponDesc: "That weapon. I've wanted it since you walked in. Hand it over and we're square."
fuelScavenge.giveWeaponDeal: You set {{weapon}} on the counter. They smile. +2 fuel.
fuelScavenge.leaveArmorDesc: "The armor. I'm interested. You fight just fine without it, I'm sure." They hold out a hand.
fuelScavenge.leaveArmorDeal: The armor changes hands. You'll be more vulnerable now. +2 fuel.
fuelScavenge.dirtyWorkDesc: "I've got a problem with the level-three pipes. It leaks, it stinks, nobody wants to touch it. You will. Two hours, one unit."
fuelScavenge.dirtyWorkDeal: Two hours later, you're covered in stuff you'd rather not identify. +1 fuel. (-8 rep)
fuelScavenge.giveIntelDesc: "You've traveled. You've seen things. Tell me what you know about movements in this sector."
fuelScavenge.giveIntelDeal: You talk. They take notes. This intel might cost more than you think. +2 fuel. (-12 rep)
fuelScavenge.giveIntelWhyNot: They don't see you as someone who knows anything useful
